values.note: City of Cando: full and partial hookups $25 a day, $150 a week, $450 a month; primitive (no utilities) $15 a day. Cash or check only, self-register at the gate receptacle or pay at the city office. Read 2026-11-12.

Cash or Check only.'), read 2026-11-12

note: City of Cando campground (state-certified) at the northeast edge of town, about 1/2 mi east on 1st St; bathhouse and picnic shelter with electric, pavilion for rent. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 5 full 50-amp + 9 water/electric sites, $25/day ($15 primitive), FCFS self-register cash/check, bathhouse with hot showers. Note trimmed of field facts. No season dates posted. Pin not confirmed on imagery.
flags: PIN UNCONFIRMED: the stored pin 48.49330,-99.20010 lies at the north edge of town beside a gravel yard and a wooded block; I could not pick out a campground loop or hookup pads on Esri imagery, and Overpass was down (timeouts/406). The city page says 'northeast edge of Cando. Go East on 1st St approx. 1/2 mile'. Google Maps returned no listing for the campground itself (a 'Cando City Campground' query returned Towner City Park). Left for a human.
Phone 701-968-3632 confirmed as the City Office (Mon-Thu); weekends City Public Works 701-720-1670. Website confirmed.
LONG-STAY: the city posts weekly ($150) and monthly ($450) rates beside the $25 daily rate; all sites are first-come with nothing discouraging nightly guests, so no long-stay flag.
Season: the page carries only a banner 'The Campground is now OPEN for the Season' (no dates); season left unset.
